reviewer.freshContextEvidence: Fresh delegated task /root/accessibility_domain_r1 was created solely to review the accessibility domain at revision 118302e080598a147294e32d40cf5296763c8cc4; it did not act as or inherit the Builder role.

findings.summary: The accepted Brief and Spec require Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA on every screen, but EXAM.md lines 273-284 define OR-21 as zero critical or serious axe-core violations and constrain OR-22 to a decision flow and two card types. Axe impact labels are not a WCAG conformance oracle, and an applicable AA failure outside those impact levels or manual surfaces can still pass the stated cases.
findings.requiredResolution: Revise OR-21 and OR-22 so the release verdict explicitly evaluates every applicable WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 requirement for every in-scope screen and interaction, identifies which requirements are automated versus manually evaluated, and fails on any unresolved conformance failure regardless of an axe impact label.

findings.summary: OR-21 at EXAM.md lines 273-276 says a future input manifest freezes every route, Storybook state, and required desktop/mobile viewport, but the Exam neither enumerates nor content-hash binds the authoritative inventory or numeric viewports. A manifest can therefore omit a route, decision or specialist card state, correction path, or signed/unsigned state and still satisfy its own frozen list, allowing the false pass the packet explicitly forbids.
findings.requiredResolution: Enumerate in the Exam, or bind by path and SHA-256 at the Exam revision, the complete route, Storybook-state, interaction-state, and numeric desktop/mobile viewport inventory. Include decision cards, specialist/escalation cards, correction and error paths, loading/empty/permission/stale/breached states, and signed and unsigned states, with a completeness check against the shipped route and story registries.

findings.summary: OR-22 at EXAM.md lines 278-284 calls the 81-checkpoint model versioned but gives no version, repository path, or digest, and it does not require checkpoint-level raw results. Its scenario text does not expressly test focus management, semantic name/role/state, announcements, error recovery, streamed conversation content, dialogs, correction paths, or signature confirmation, so the manual result cannot be reproduced or shown complete from the required evidence record.
findings.requiredResolution: Bind the exact 81-checkpoint model by versioned path and SHA-256; define the complete manual scenario matrix for keyboard and supported screen-reader/browser/OS combinations; explicitly cover focus, semantics, announcements, recovery, streaming, dialogs, correction, and signature confirmation; and require raw checkpoint-by-checkpoint results plus the signed summary at the exact Exam and implementation revisions.

escalations.reason: The accessibility Exam review found two unresolved blockers and one unresolved major finding that can permit incomplete or non-reproducible release evidence.
The authoritative route/state/viewport inventory and the exact versioned 81-checkpoint model are absent from the bound Exam evidence, so completeness cannot be established.

The accepted Brief invokes Section 508 and the accepted Spec requires the platform pod's DHS Trusted Tester review at Gate 3 for new UI; an agent review cannot replace that required human specialist judgment.

This item contains user-facing decision, escalation, conversation, and board surfaces. The mandatory human keyboard and screen-reader validation remains a technical-release/Gate 3 obligation and is not evidence that the Gate 2 Exam or any future implementation has passed.
